Asset Caption.extract_value: Figure 3. Moderated structural equation model results. Standardized path coefficients are reported. Although the model does not depict this, we controlled for the effects of cognitive ability on knowledge and performance. Interactive effects are reported in italics and are represented by the individual difference path that bisects the path from the respective training design element. When a significant interaction term is present, the main effects are conditional, although the direct relationship can be interpreted as the average effect (Aiken & West, 1991). Dashed lines represent exploratory paths. *p < .05. **p < .01.
